# Roses

> Polish American cooking built on Michigan produce, in a 28-seat diner at 10551 E Jefferson Ave, Detroit, MI 48214. Dinner only: Sunday, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday 4pm to 10pm, Friday and Saturday 4pm to 11pm, closed Tuesday. Chef and owner Molly Mitchell.

This is a concept site by Summit Software Solutions and is not affiliated with Roses. The restaurant's own site is https://rosesdetroit.com/.

- Phone: +1-313-332-0404
- Reservations: Resy, thirty days out, for the dining room and the bar. Walk-ins welcome.
- Formerly Rose's Fine Food (2014 to 2023). Roses opened in the same room in September 2025.
- Detroit Free Press 2026 Restaurant of the Year; The New York Times, 50 favorite restaurants in America; The Detroit News, three stars; Hour Detroit Best New Restaurants 2026.

## Pages

- [Menu](https://ryankolean.github.io/roses/menu.html): the full dinner menu as text, dated, with Menu structured data. It changes with what the farms bring.
- [Visit](https://ryankolean.github.io/roses/visit.html): hours, address, map, reservations and what to expect.
- [Story](https://ryankolean.github.io/roses/story.html): Rose's Fine Food from 2014 to 2023, the reopening in 2025, and the producers.
- [Press](https://ryankolean.github.io/roses/press.html): the four awards and reviews, with links to the originals.
